summary: Reproduced both concrete counterexamples against candidate PR https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/1564 at 5e007ae4fb75b5b0b68c0c37a7ffe913239ca402, as independently reported by https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/1630. The correction preserves bounded recovery while enforcing it in token space and replaces vocabulary-dependent fixed token id 100 with a complete token derived from the active tokenizer.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing before: 5 failed, 2 passed. Replacement streams never committed, the oversized event remained unbounded, and fixed simulation had no tokenizer-derived token interface. Raw output: /job/review-evidence/j-69fb2eb5a4ec/failing-before.log

Passing after: 15 tests passed, covering ordinary and oversized invalid-byte events, split UTF-8, clean reset behavior, safe token resolution, fixed-token filling, and existing stop trimming. Raw output: /job/review-evidence/j-69fb2eb5a4ec/passing-after.log

On gfx950, the corrected real tensor path resolved token 64 decoding to 'a' and produced predict_unique=[64], versus predict_unique=[100] on the exact candidate. Raw output: /job/review-evidence/j-69fb2eb5a4ec/gpu-after.log

tests.command: pre-commit run --files <all changed Python source and tests>
tests.what_was_measured: All configured hooks passed, including AST, import sorting, Ruff, formatting, codespell, and CI registry validation.

gpu_evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, executed and synchronized the corrected generate_simulated_accept_index tensor path with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. This was not a model-serving run.
remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4-Pro weights and its tokenizer were unavailable, so the reported model semantics were not directly verified.
The reported eight-GPU TP/DP/EAGLE serving workload, throughput, TTFT, and distributed topology were not reproduced.
The deterministic tokenizer fixture qualifies the Python detokenizer and simulated-acceptance control flow; the single-GPU fixture qualifies tensor execution only.
No native source changed and repository-environment.json declares native=null, so no native rebuild was applicable.
